stem.text: The diagram shows the Boltzmann distribution of the energy of gaseous molecules at a particular temperature.

stem.alt: Boltzmann distribution: proportion of molecules with energy E against molecular energy E. The curve rises from the origin to a single maximum, then falls gradually. Labelled Y is a vertical double arrow from the axis up to the maximum; labelled X is a short double arrow on the tail of the curve.

A.text: If the temperature of the gas is raised, the height of the maximum of the curve increases.

B.text: If the temperature of the gas is raised, the maximum of the curve moves to the right.

C.text: The length of the line labelled X shows the activation energy for the reaction.

D.text: The length of the line labelled Y shows the enthalpy change of the reaction.
